headline: Last session: Sensex plunged 1,484 points as profit-taking ended rally; markets closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: NSE and BSE are closed today in observance of the Guru Nanak Jayanti holiday.
Heavy selling in banking and metal sectors pressured the indices during the last session.
Investors engaged in significant profit-taking following a sustained four-week market rally.
Weak global market cues contributed to the downward trend observed on Monday.
whatHappening: The Sensex shed 1,484 points while the Nifty 50 dropped below the 25,400 level in the previous session.
HDFC Bank and Reliance Industries were identified among the top stocks with the highest DII holdings in Q2.
Google Cloud India confirmed the elimination of 30 roles, clarifying that claims of massive layoffs were inaccurate.
Market experts are debating the need for tax stability regarding Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) over ad-hoc fixes.
summary: Indian markets are closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti following a sharp correction in the previous session. On Monday, the Sensex plummeted 1,484 points, ending a four-week winning streak due to heavy selling in banking and metal sectors. Trading is scheduled to resume on Wednesday, November 25.
